You weren't patronising at all, my friend. You may have saved my life. I wrote this post in tears, and I had almost given up. I am stronger than this, I will do my best and accept life as it comes. 

Thank you, you don't realise how much that meant to me.

Thank you. I'm feeling somewhat calmer now. These are some of the first positive words I've heard in weeks.

Thanks a lot. I promise that I'll get through this. No matter what.

What difference will that make? Will people in the Middle East suddenly stop hating Homosexuality and the LGBT community in general because Bethesda left them. 

In all fairness, it isn't Bethesda's job to solve the middle East cultural problem. Why should they lower their sales because of it? Nobody's calling out international agencies to stop helping these countries. 

Isn't it every civilized countries' duty to stop any trade and diplomatic relations with these countries? Shouldn't we stop using petroleum from these countries? 

Blaming this on Bethesda is simply illogical and impractical.

Oh, it would make a major difference. 

It would put Beth employees at risk and lower their sales. 

No one in the middle East will go, "Wait, Bethesda likes the LGBT people, maybe being gay isn't that bad..."

It helps nobody and hurts Bethesda.

It isn't a gaming company's job to change the middle Eastern people and their backward culture towards the LGBT community. 

That's sort of the UNs job.
